observed: Owner screenshot shows selected ChatGPT composer and visible alien with AF-E10. It contains no offset/selection diagnostic; exact phone case remains unknown.
cause: Android's default InputConnection.getSurroundingText returns a bounded window with offset=-1. The old guard required exact full field contents for any unknown offset, rejecting supported partial windows in longer drafts.
repair: An immutable absolute selection from EditorInfo/onUpdateSelection is attached only if its identical observation survives the read. Unknown-offset partial windows require both absolute endpoints, selection width, exact shared characters and complete mutation coverage to agree. No substring search, normalization, timeout increase or resends.
verification: Test invokes the actual framework default InputConnection method through a Java proxy forwarding native EditText operations, verifies offset=-1 and bounded contents, then exercises production bridge insertion, Unicode correction and intervening typing with preserved unrelated anchors.
A contradictory selection callback dispatches no selection or commit. Missing callbacks, changed text, width disagreement and insufficient mutation coverage are rejected.
